fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 28% match is a WEAK FIT for this Customer Success Manager role.

**Strengths:**
- One-to-one coaching and workshop facilitation (relationship-building groundwork)
- Head of Year 9 role (pastoral leadership, stakeholder management)
- Excel pivot tables, basic Python pandas (data analysis)

**Gaps:**
- No 5-7 years in a customer-facing commercial role
- No contract negotiation, pricing objection handling or up-selling experience
- No customer success methodology or renewal risk identification

**Recommendation:** Build commercial experience first, for example through an entry-level customer success or onboarding role at a SaaS company, before targeting this position.

coverLetter:
Daniel Okafor
Leeds, UK
daniel.okafor@example.org
+44 20 5550 0188

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Datadog

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your ad describes a Customer Success Manager who has to advise customers so they use the product well, and who spots usage trends before they turn into renewal risks. That is a teaching problem as much as a sales one. In 8 years in the classroom, I've raised the share of Year 11 students reaching grade 5 or above from 71% to 86% over three years by tracking progress in spreadsheets and adjusting how I explained things.

As Head of Year 9 at Ashgrove Academy, I run weekly parent calls for a year group of 210 students, so building trust through regular, honest conversations is already part of my week. I wrote the department's Year 9 practical curriculum and trained 12 colleagues to use it, which is the kind of onboarding work your Support, Product and Finance teams would expect me to handle with care. I'm comfortable in Excel, Google Sheets and basic Python (pandas), and I'm working through the Google Data Analytics Certificate. I haven't held a customer success title, and I won't pretend the contract negotiation side is behind me. I do learn quickly, and your onboarding and MEDDIC training suit that.

You say not everyone meets every qualification on day one. I'd like to show you in an interview how my teaching and data habits would serve your customers in Boston. I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Customer Success Manager, Daniel Okafor
applicationEmail.body:
Dear Datadog Hiring Team,

After 8 years of teaching, I know how to explain complex things clearly, and I've built trust with families through weekly parent calls and tracked student progress in spreadsheets to report results to senior leadership.

That mix of clear communication, relationship building and data work is what I'd bring to onboarding and supporting your customers.

I've attached my CV and cover letter so you can see the detail.

I'm available for a call any weekday and can start a conversation this week.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor

followUpEmail.body:
Dear Datadog Hiring Team,

I applied for the Customer Success Manager role last week and remain very interested.

I'm drawn to the emphasis on partnering with sales for a smooth customer onboarding experience. At Ashgrove Academy, I wrote a practical curriculum and trained 12 colleagues to use it, so I know how to guide people through a new process.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how that could support your onboarding.

Best regards,
Daniel Okafor
